# Repository guidelines

Read and follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md` before making changes.

For every change, read and follow `AI Coding Guidelines.md` and review `AI Coding Guidelines Sources.md`, consulting linked sources when relevant.

For UI, appearance, interaction, or accessibility changes, also read and follow `AI Coding UI Guidelines.md` and review `AI Coding UI Guidelines Sources.md`.

Use the current repository documents as the source of truth. Follow their verification requirements and report the checks performed and any checks that could not be completed.
